assertion: Petite/all-petite/unicase use native small-cap fallbacks where present. Each row matches its explicit OpenType-feature control. Synthetic casing, caseless characters and byte indices are covered by text unit tests.

browser.reason: Chrome applies all three specified fallbacks, including unicase to small-cap uppercase glyphs. Firefox leaves unicase unchanged and WebKit differs in petite fallback. Same fixed font and OpenType control in each row; only glyph edge rasterization is allowed.
